entities.name: RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message used for relay authentication procedure containing protocol discriminator, security header, transaction identity, and EAP authentication data.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for NAS messages.

entities.description: Indicates the security protection applied to the message.

entities.name: Relay authentication request message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

entities.name: PRTI
entities.description: ProSe relay transaction identity used to correlate relay authentication transactions.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Contains Extensible Authentication Protocol data for relay authentication.
